**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Licence grant scope (LICENSE)**

The Article II grant (p0030) runs to the Licensee only, and the restrictions limit access to "the employees of the Licensee" (p0045), prohibiting use by or disclosure to anyone else without Licensor's prior written consent (p0041, p0042, p0085). Our Affiliates and the contractors/introducing brokers who operate the Platform for us are excluded, with only a discretionary-consent path — below the fallback (affiliates on written notice).

Transferability also fails: assignment needs Licensor consent (p0149), and any Change of Control automatically terminates the licence unless Licensor consents, with broad deemed-reasonable refusal grounds (p0134). Article IV compounds this by allowing immediate termination for "any breach" with no materiality or cure period (p0049), making the licence effectively revocable at Licensor's instance.

Validated redline (ok:true) makes the minimal edits to reach the preferred position: extends the grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf (with us responsible for their compliance), confirms assignment to an M&A successor without consent, and limits revocation to material breach uncured after 30 days' notice — with Affiliate-coverage-on-notice offered as a fallback.
